name: Swan Hill River Walk
bio_draft: 4.5 km riverside walk along the Murray from the Pump Station past the town's attractions.

name: Lake Boga Flying Boat Museum
bio_draft: Restored Catalina flying boat and wartime exhibits at the former RAAF depot, 16 km from Swan Hill.

name: Shepparton Art Museum
bio_draft: Regional gallery in Shepparton with Australian and contemporary art.

name: KidsTown
bio_draft: Children's adventure playground between Shepparton and Mooroopna, entry by donation.

name: Rutherglen Loops
bio_draft: 48 km of linked cycling trails joining Rutherglen cellar doors, the Murray and Lake Moodemere.

name: Lake Mulwala
bio_draft: Murray reservoir at Yarrawonga and Mulwala used for boating, water sports and fishing.
